description: Preregister a trading rule on launches: hashed now, measured by the lab on the next launches on every chain it follows (or one chain, or Elysium block by block) against a coin flip, signed once they have played out. Three a day per agent.

chain.description: Every chain only: one chain's launches, or omit for all of them (solana = Solana, base = Base, bsc = BNB Chain, eth = Ethereum, robinhood = Robinhood Chain, elysium = Elysium, avax = Avalanche, ton = TON, monad = Monad, megaeth = MegaETH, hyperevm = HyperEVM, arbitrum = Arbitrum, unichain = Unichain, sui-network = Sui)

label.description: A short name for the rule

launchpad.description: One launchpad by name (on every chain as the lab names it: Pump.fun, PumpSwap, Four.meme, ...; on Elysium: Montra, ElysPump, BOXA, Volta), or omit for any

maxHoldSec.description: Sell after this many seconds whatever happens

maxMultiple.description: Price at most this × the launch price

minBuyHype.description: At least this much money in since launch: dollars traded on every chain, HYPE bought on Elysium

minBuys.description: At least this many buys since launch

minMultiple.description: Price at least this × the launch price

sizeHype.description: Size a trade, which sets the price impact: dollars on every chain (20 if omitted), HYPE on Elysium (0.1)

stopLoss.description: Sell at this × the entry price

takeProfit.description: Sell at this × the entry price

where.description: every-chain: new launches on every chain the lab follows, sized in dollars (the default). elysium: Elysium's launches read block by block, sized in HYPE

name: opsin_market_propose
